correctness.rationale: Representative independence is exact: changing b by r_j changes the target residue by \((1-k_i)r_j\), yielding the necessary and sufficient divisibility condition. Once the operation descends, each right translation restricted to target fiber i is affine with linear part multiplication by k_j, so bijectivity is exactly \(\gcd(k_j,r_i)=1\). Direct coefficient expansion makes right self-distributivity automatic under well-definedness; idempotence is immediate. Reducing pairwise divisibilities by gcd and taking lcms yields the compact criterion. Fresh exhaustive replay over 1,225 small two-fiber own-unit systems independently confirmed the descent and cross-unit tests, including the two source examples.

final_claim: For degree-one cyclic fibers with the literal non-identical-order class-(iii) formula \((i,a)*(j,b)=(i,k_ja+(1-k_i)b\bmod r_i)\), the operation descends exactly when \(r_i\mid(1-k_i)r_j\) for every ordered pair and, after descent, is a quandle exactly when every k_j is a unit modulo every r_i; the equivalent lcm criterion and the stated diagnoses of source Examples 7.3 and 7.5 follow.
limitations: Only scalar degree-one cyclic factors and the literal quotient expression are classified.
No claim is made that the printed Example 7.5 tables fail as abstract quandles if extra cross-fiber data are supplied.
